narr: Upper level moisture which sheared off from former Pacific Hurricane Jova fueled isolated thunderstorms in far northwest Arizona. One produced flash flooding.
ev: Flash flooding of Short Creek closed all of the Colorado City roads which cross the creek. The Hildale Street crossing was heavily damaged and will likely be closed for some time.
lsr: Hildale Fire Dispatch reported flooding across Hildale and Colorado City. All creek crossing roads were closed for 2-3 hours during the storm yesterday with the creek out of its banks and flash flood
